artifact.title: Geofenced Time‑Punch Validation Microservice Function
artifact.description: Implement a Python microservice function `validate_punch(employee_id: int, timestamp: datetime, lat: float, lng: float) -> ValidationResult` that validates an employee punch‑in/out. The function must verify that the geographic location is within 100 meters of the office coordinates (12.9716, 77.5946) and that the timestamp falls between 06:00 and 22:00 office local time. The function returns a JSON object `{ "valid": bool, "reason": str }`. The implementation must use strictly typed Pydantic models for input and output.
acceptance_criteria: Given a punch at (12.9716, 77.5946) at 09:30 local time, `validate_punch` returns `{"valid": true, "reason": "Punch accepted"}`.
Given a punch 200 m away from the office, the function returns `{"valid": false, "reason": "Location out of range"}`.
Given a punch at 05:45 local time, the function returns `{"valid": false, "reason": "Time outside allowed window"}`.

entities.name: Employee
entities.description: Represents an employee who can perform a punch.

relationships.description: Each punch references the employee who performed it.

constraints: Use only standard Python library and Pydantic.
non_functional_requirements: The function must respond within 50 ms.
The code must be type‑checked with mypy.
